purpose: Teach: 馳せ/繰り出し/ベター/つぶす/まわす/喰い/飛び込む/おこない

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、修学旅行に思いを馳せてるな
lines.en: Riku, you're really caught up in thinking about the school trip, aren't you?
lines.style: Teasing, knowing smirk in the voice. Leans on the observation like she's caught him daydreaming. Light, familiar — the tone of someone who notices and likes needling a friend about it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お祭りの繰り出しの太鼓叩いたな、桜
lines.en: You were the one beating the drum at the festival parade, Sakura.
lines.style: Calm redirect, matter-of-fact. Not defensive — just pointing out what he noticed. Small smile underneath, returning the observation with quiet accuracy.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ベターな勉強法に変えろよ
lines.en: Riku, you should switch up how you're studying. It's not working.
lines.style: Direct, practical tone. No sugar-coating. The words land like friendly advice, not criticism — she's pushing because she thinks he can do better.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、宿題を週末でつぶすつもりだろ、桜
lines.en: You're planning to knock out all your homework on the weekend, aren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Gentle call-out, slightly amused. Quiet certainty — he knows her patterns. Not lecturing, just stating what he's observed with a touch of wry humor.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ペンをまわすの上手いな
lines.en: Riku, you're actually really good at spinning a pen like that.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation, a little surprised at herself for saying it out loud. Brief, warm. The kind of small praise that matters more because she doesn't overdress it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、給食を喰い過ぎだぞ、桜
lines.en: You're eating way too much at lunch, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry observation, almost deadpan. There's no judgment in it — just pointing out something obvious with understated humor. Small shake of the head.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、プールに飛び込む練習しろよ
lines.en: Riku, you need to actually practice diving into the pool.
lines.style: Firm but not unkind directive. She means it — there's intention behind the words. No room for argument, but delivered like she believes he can do it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、普段のおこないが大事だぞ、桜
lines.en: How you act every day — that's what actually matters, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet conviction, slower pace. Settles the words like they carry weight. Not preachy — just sincere, the way he only gets when he means something.
